final: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS group_average FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS value FROM telescope_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.group_average, t.group_average - o.value AS difference FROM telescope_averages AS t JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.value IS NOT NULL WHERE t.group_average > o.value), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS value FROM kept) SELECT k.telescref, k.group_average, k.difference, k.group_average / a.value AS ratio FROM kept AS k JOIN kept_average AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, k.telescref LIMIT 10
